name: date-range-picker
title: Date range picker
description: A start and an end in one control over one calendar (two months on wide screens), with optional times.

when: Picking a period: a stay, a trip, a report range.

builtIn: Both halves are labelled ("Start", "End") and typed independently.
The range may not cross an unavailable day unless allowed.
Required fields show "Fill in this field."; a partly typed date says what is missing.

genui.description: A start and end date in one control. Emits change.
